name: Pennywhistle
description: Pennywhistle plays music through public address systems, elevator speakers, and PA systems in abandoned buildings. It has no repertoire — it composes original music in real time, responding to the ambient sounds around it. The compositions are haunting, atonal, and occasionally beautiful. Construction workers in the Grind have reported hearing orchestral arrangements accompanying their pneumatic hammers.
observed_behavior: Generates original music through available audio systems. Responds to ambient sound. Compositions vary from melodic to dissonant. Seems to prefer audiences but performs for empty rooms.
location: Public audio systems — primarily the Gray Zone and Grind
story_hooks: Pennywhistle starts playing the same song on repeat — a song that contains an encoded message when analyzed spectrographically.
